# ship-pipeline

Your interface to the `pipeline` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Commands

- [`pipeline.update_status`](references/docs/pipeline.update_status.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Advance a pipeline run's lifecycle/gate state (the agent's own run).
- [`pipeline.step_done`](references/docs/pipeline.step_done.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Agent declares the current pipeline step complete.
